blocks.text: No parentheses are needed around the condition; you write `:` at the end and indent the lines below by 4 spaces. Chain `elif` for several cases; `else` catches everything left.
The first branch that is true runs and the rest are skipped. That is why you put the biggest thresholds first.

blocks.prompt: Finish the chain: print `Cold` when `temperature` is below 10, `Hot` when it is above 25, and `Mild` otherwise.
blocks.hint: Replace the three `?` with `Cold`, `Hot`, `Mild` in this order.

blocks.q: If several branches are true, how many run?
blocks.why: An `if`/`elif` chain stops at the first true branch.
